scope: Read-only derivation from frozen actual rustc.jsonl, six metadata pairs, serial, private profile and selected exact producer sources. It adds no new test result.

source_explanations.interpretation: OSDK replaces child RUSTFLAGS with its constructed action/config flags.
This v1 opt-in runner put the remap only in the outer RUSTFLAGS environment.

root_cause_inference: The v1 metadata projection maps component identities to the virtual root, while actual selected kernel rustc invocations have no remap and runtime records the real source root. OSDK action build flags overwrite the runner outer RUSTFLAGS. The observed panic is consistent with and directly exposes that identity mismatch; this phase does not test a fix.
